supportingSources.label: Data East Simpsons exact-machine gameplay and tutorial

strategy.summary: Shoot the left ramp for M-I-L-L-I-O-N-S while you build Multiball. Complete the center drops, lock one ball for two-ball play, and relock both balls before the timer ends. During three-ball play, complete the center bank, keep switches active, and collect the one Jackpot at the left ramp.

quickInfo.name: Two-Ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Complete the bowling-pin bank and lock at a lit saucer to release a second ball.

quickInfo.name: Three-Ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: During two-ball play, relock both balls in different saucers before the timer expires.

quickInfo.name: Multiball Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: Complete the center bank during three-ball play and shoot the left ramp for the one available Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Simpsons Millions
quickInfo.summary: Spell M-I-L-L-I-O-N-S at the left ramp, then repeat the ramp for 1,000,000 during the timer.

quickInfo.name: Mystery
quickInfo.summary: Two quick left ramps at ball start or after multiball award one displayed mystery value.

steps.text: Plunge through an unlit top lane and use either flipper to move the lit lanes toward a completion.
Test the left ramp. Repeat it from the right-inlane return only when that feed stays controlled.
Use the left ramp to add M-I-L-L-I-O-N-S letters while you work toward the center bank.
modeNotes: Simpsons Millions: Completing the word starts a timed mode with 1,000,000 at each left-ramp shot.

steps.text: Complete the three center bowling-pin drops and shoot any saucer lit for Lock.
modeNotes: Two-Ball Multiball: The first lock releases with an autoplunged replacement ball.

steps.text: During two-ball play, lock one ball in any saucer and read the relock timer.
Put the second ball into a different saucer before the timer ends, then plunge the third ball.
modeNotes: Failed relock: If time expires, the first held ball ejects and the two-ball relock attempt must start again.
Three-Ball Multiball: The third plunge releases both held balls for the Jackpot phase.

steps.text: Complete the center bowling-pin bank once to light Jackpot at the left ramp.
Keep balls moving through safe switches while Jackpot rises from 1,000,000 toward 4,000,000.
modeNotes: Jackpot growth: Long periods without switch activity can lower the displayed value.

steps.text: Shoot the left ramp for the one Jackpot collect, then use safe play until one ball remains.
Return to left-ramp letters and the next multiball qualification.

fallback.title: Recovery: Simpsons Millions
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this when the center targets or timed relocks are unsafe.

steps.text: Repeat the left ramp to spell M-I-L-L-I-O-N-S.
When the mode starts, repeat the ramp for 1,000,000.
A made ramp briefly pauses the timer during its callout.
Stop after a dangerous return; the mode has no grace period.
Each scored Million shortens the next mode timer by two seconds to a five-second minimum.

alternatives.title: Position play: Opening Mystery double ramp
alternatives.when: When trailing, use this higher-ceiling route: use this at ball start or after multiball when the ramp loop is reliable.

steps.text: Shoot the lit left ramp once.
Repeat the ramp before the short timer ends.
Accept the displayed Mystery award and return to the main route.
Do not depend on a specific random award.

alternatives.title: Right-bank awards
alternatives.when: Use this when the right drops are safe and awards have tournament value.

steps.text: Complete the bank once and shoot the near-left saucer for Bonus Hold.
Complete it again and shoot the upper-right saucer for Extra Ball.
Complete it again and shoot the upper-left saucer for Special.
Stop after an unsafe direct-bank rebound.
Complete the center bank and start Two-Ball Multiball.
Relock both balls before the timer ends and start Three-Ball Multiball.
Complete the center bank again.
Keep switch activity high while Jackpot grows.
Shoot the left ramp for the one Jackpot.
Repeat the qualification later; the game has no separate wizard mode.

techniques.name: Lane change
techniques.instruction: Use either flipper to move the lit top lanes in the same direction before the ball rolls through.

techniques.name: Left-ramp loop
techniques.instruction: Take the next left-ramp shot from the right-inlane return only when the copy feeds it cleanly.

techniques.name: Timed two-ball relock
techniques.instruction: Use the safest first saucer, then shoot a different saucer with the live ball before the timer ends.

techniques.name: Multiball activity control
techniques.instruction: Use safe switch shots to keep Jackpot rising instead of holding every ball until the value falls.

cautions.issue: The open playfield and wide left drain feed both outlanes.
cautions.response: Keep the left-outlane Laser Kick lit and relight it at the lower-left standups after use.

cautions.issue: The second two-ball relock is timed and the first ball ejects at zero.
cautions.response: Read the display before you choose the first saucer.

cautions.issue: Simpsons Millions has no grace period.
cautions.response: Do not start a final ramp shot after the timer reaches zero.

cautions.issue: Three-Ball Multiball has one Jackpot collect.
cautions.response: After the left-ramp collect, use safe play instead of chasing an unavailable second Jackpot.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm the 1990 Data East game and relock timer.
Test each saucer eject, left-ramp return, and Laser Kick.
strategy.simpleOverview: The Simpsons uses the center bowling-pin drops and lit saucers to turn one lock into two-ball play, then two timed relocks start three-ball Multiball. Complete the center bank, take the first lock, relock both balls before time expires, then complete the bank again and shoot the left ramp for Jackpot.
strategy.overview: The Simpsons uses the center bowling-pin drops and lit saucers to turn one lock into two-ball play, then two timed relocks start three-ball Multiball. Complete the bank again during Multiball, keep safe switches active to raise the Jackpot, and collect once at the left ramp. Use that ramp for M-I-L-L-I-O-N-S letters between Multiballs.
machineSetup: Confirm the 1990 Data East game and relock timer.
Test each saucer eject, left-ramp return, and Laser Kick.
